title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is edging up. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 6,900 and 8,500 ft, with sun above it. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 2 mph. Trades are holding the shear line north of Pukalani, reaching the coast near Haiku, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
